# WaterEjector

> Free online browser audio utility to eject water, remove dust, and restore crystal-clear speaker sound across smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, and headphones.

WaterEjector provides specialized acoustic frequency tools, haptic vibration modes, and diagnostic utilities using the standard W3C Web Audio API to solve water damage, speaker muffling, port moisture warnings, and channel imbalances without software installation.

## Core Audio Tools

- [Water Eject](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/): Primary 165Hz pulsed acoustic tone generator designed to break surface tension and eject water droplets from smartphone loudspeakers.
- [Deep Clean Dust Remover](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/deep-clean/): Ultra-low frequency acoustic sweeping tool that dislodges dry dust, sand particles, and compacted pocket lint from speaker grilles.
- [Vibration Mode](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/vibration/): 80Hz mechanical haptic oscillation combined with audio vibration to physically shake stubborn moisture out of phone speakers.
- [Left / Right Stereo Tester](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/stereo-test/): Dual-channel audio isolation utility to diagnose volume disparities, blocked earbud grilles, and driver polarity issues.
- [Custom Frequency Generator](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/frequency-generator/): Full-range sine wave generator from 1Hz to 20,000Hz for custom resonant frequency tuning, subwoofer testing, and hearing range checks.
- [Liquid in Charging Port Fix](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/charging-port-fix/): Emergency guidance and 30-minute calibrated evaporation countdown timer for the "Liquid Detected in Lightning Connector" or "Moisture Detected in USB Port" warning.
- [Online Microphone Tester](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/mic-test/): Client-side 5-second voice recording and playback diagnostic to check microphone clarity, background noise, and water blockage.
- [Speaker Rescue Arcade Game](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/game/): Free browser mini-game simulating 165Hz acoustic shockwave physics to blast falling water droplets and dust out of smartphone speaker grilles.
- [Sonic Droplet Ghost Challenge](https://waterejector.devdeskapp.com/sonic-droplet/): Free acoustic obstacle arcade game pulsing water droplets through speaker grille barriers with custom cosmetic skins and zero-backend ghost replay racing.
